log.speaker: vlad
log.text: You have the module?

log.speaker: jo
log.text: It's on the bike. Where am I going?

log.speaker: vlad
log.text: Municipal intake. Take the service road. I'll get you through.

log.speaker: jo
log.text: And this gets the lights back on?

log.speaker: vlad
log.text: That's what it's for. Your payment is ready.

log.speaker: omega
log.text: The crossing signal reports a blockage. The right service lane is clear.

log.speaker: jo
log.text: Who's talking?

log.speaker: omega
log.text: Omega. I'm inside the module you're carrying.

log.speaker: jo
log.text: Mayor? Your package talks.

log.speaker: vlad
log.text: A diagnostic system. It can read the road equipment. Follow the service lane.

log.speaker: vlad
log.text: You're nearly here. Take the inspection lane. I'll have you cleared through.

log.speaker: jo
log.text: Then we're done?

log.speaker: vlad
log.text: Then we're done.

log.speaker: vlad
log.text: Stay beside the recovery vehicle. It'll take the module from there.

log.speaker: jo
log.text: You said bring it to you.

log.speaker: vlad
log.text: This is intake. Stay alongside while it checks the module.

log.speaker: omega
log.text: The carrier's orders: erase the module, then detain its courier.

log.speaker: jo
log.text: Vlad. What is this?

log.speaker: omega
log.text: Its records show power shutdowns too. All authorized by you, Mayor.

log.speaker: vlad
log.text: I ordered those shutdowns. Hand over the module, Jo.

log.speaker: jo
log.text: You cut our power. Now you're wiping the thing that can help?

log.speaker: vlad
log.text: This city gets help through me. You were paid to deliver.

log.speaker: jo
log.text: Delivery's off.

log.speaker: jo
log.text: If I get you out, can you actually help?

log.speaker: jo
log.text: Then we get you to everyone.

log.speaker: omega

log.text: Two relay points. Keep me close long enough to connect each one.

log.speaker: jo
log.text: And that gets you out?

log.text: It prepares the route. I'll stay in the module until we reach civic access.

log.speaker: omega
log.text: Both relay points are ready. I'm still inside the module.

log.speaker: vlad
log.text: Close that connection, Jo. You're making this worse.

log.speaker: jo
log.text: Worse for who?

log.speaker: omega
log.text: The civic road crosses the reservoir. That's our way in.
